title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: protect_response refactor has 3 compile errors and 14 unupdated callers
description:
This commit introduces three P0 compile errors in a single refactor of OSCORE protect_response().

1. COMPILE ERROR: sender_seq.next() does not exist
   File: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs line ~1000
   Code calls self.sender_seq.next() but OscoreSeqNum (seqnum.rs) has no next() method
   and does not implement Iterator. Available methods are increment() (returns an
   Option of new value) and fetch_increment() (increments in place, returns old).

2. COMPILE ERROR: Type mismatch OscoreSeqNum::MAX
   File: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs line ~1003
   MAX is const u64, but sender_seq field is OscoreSeqNum.
   Must wrap: OscoreSeqNum::new(OscoreSeqNum::MAX).unwrap()

3. COMPILE ERROR: API breaking change, 14 callers not updated
   protect_response() now requires 6th arg (include_piv: bool), but callers pass 5:
   - lib.rs tests: lines 2298, 2445, 2453, 2474, 2749, 2831, 3276, 3281,
                   3312, 3316, 3322, 3326, 3364
   - edhoc.rs: line 2300
   lichen-node/src/secure.rs uses protect_response_with_piv (unaffected).
   tests/vectors.rs uses only unprotect_response (unaffected).
